description: Erection of a part three storey rear extension at basement, ground and first floor levels with creation of a rear lightwell. Basement conversion with creation of a front bay window and front lightwell. Front garden/ drive gradient slope altered. Internal reconfiguration of existing flats.
decision_conditions:
<p>The Development hereby permitted shall only be carried out and completed 
strictly in accordance with the submitted plans hereby approved and any 
subsequent approval of details.
</p><p> REASON: To ensure that the development hereby permitted is carried out in 
full accordance with the plans hereby approved.</p>

<p>The flat roof area of the two storey extension shall not be used for 
any purpose other than as a means of escape in emergency or for maintenance 
of the building. In particular the roof shall not be used as a roof terrace, area 
for planting, balcony or any other amenity area.</p><p>REASON: To safeguard the amenities of the adjoining premises and the area 
generally.</p>

<p>The side-facing windows on the ground floor for Flat 1 and on the first floor level for Flat 6 shall be obscurely glazed and fixed shut up to a height of 1.7m when measured internally, subject to the satisfaction of the local planning authority (LPA). Full details of these windows must be submitted to and approved by the LPA prior to occupation.&nbsp; These details must be retained in perpetuity.</p><p>

REASON:&nbsp;<span style="color: rgb(51, 51, 51);">To ensure that the external appearance of the building is satisfactory and does not detract from the character and visual amenities of the area and to protect the amenities of adjacent occupiers.</span></p>

<div style="color: rgb(34, 34, 34); font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: small;">Prior to the commencement of development:</div><div style="color: rgb(34, 34, 34); font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: small;"><br></div><div style="color: rgb(34, 34, 34); font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: small;">i) a preliminary risk assessment, which identifies all previous uses, potential&nbsp;<span class="il">contaminants</span>&nbsp;associated with those uses (including asbestos, landfill gas, vapours, and groundwater&nbsp;<span class="il">contaminants</span>); a conceptual model of the site indicating sources, pathways, and receptors; and potentially unacceptable risks arising from&nbsp;<span class="il">contamination</span>&nbsp;at the site&nbsp;shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority; and&nbsp;</div><div style="color: rgb(34, 34, 34); font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: small;"><br>ii) following the preliminary risk assessment,&nbsp; the applicant will be expected to either provide evidence to show that there is no risk from land&nbsp;<span class="il">contamination</span>&nbsp;or otherwise embark on further investigation of potential land&nbsp;<span class="il">contamination</span>&nbsp;in line with LCRM guidance, and this must be submitted to and approved by the LPA in writing prior to the commencement of any development at the site.&nbsp;</div><div style="color: rgb(34, 34, 34); font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: small;"><br></div><div style="color: rgb(34, 34, 34); font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: small;">If additional significant&nbsp;<span class="il">contamination</span>&nbsp;is found at any time when carrying out the approved development, it must immediately be reported in writing to the LPA.</div><div style="color: rgb(34, 34, 34); font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: small;"><br></div><div style="color: rgb(34, 34, 34); font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: small;">REASON: To ensure that any contamination sources at the site have been adequately dealt with in line with the legislation.&nbsp;</div>

<p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.38;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:12pt;"><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">Prior to the first occupation of the development hereby approved, detailed drawings showing the design, location, materials, and capacity of a permanent, screened refuse and recycling store within the site curtilage shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.</span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.38;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:12pt;"><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">The approved storage facilities shall be fully constructed and made available for use prior to the occupation of the extended dwelling and shall be permanently retained for the storage of waste and recycling thereafter.</span></p><p><span id="docs-internal-guid-5c8f370b-7fff-001b-c862-c3b280a52a5c"></span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.38;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:12pt;"><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">REASON: To ensure that adequate, well-designed, and secure waste and recycling storage is provided to serve the enlarged development. This prevents the unsightly accumulation of bins on the public highway or within the front garden, thereby safeguarding the visual amenity, character, and appearance of the surrounding area in accordance with Policy LP57 (Waste) and Policy LP1 (Design and Character) of the Hackney Local Plan (2020).</span></p>

<p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.38;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:12pt;"><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">Prior to the commencement of the internal fit-out works of the development hereby approved, a detailed scheme of sound insulation and structural acoustic isolation between Flat 1 and Flat 2, and between the internal floors of Flat 1, shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.</span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.38;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:12pt;"><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">The submitted scheme shall demonstrate that the sound insulation performance of the separating floors will exceed the minimum requirements of Part E of the Building Regulations, specifically addressing the stacked layout of bedrooms directly beneath living, kitchen, and open-plan areas.</span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.38;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:12pt;"><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">The approved soundproofing measures shall be fully implemented and installed prior to the first occupation of all new habitable rooms hereby approved and shall be permanently retained as such thereafter.</span></p><p><span id="docs-internal-guid-545d24d3-7fff-762d-6244-8ce2a124847e"></span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.38;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:12pt;"><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">REASON: To safeguard the residential amenity of the future occupiers by preventing adverse internal noise transmission and disturbance between conflicting habitable room layouts. This is to ensure a high standard of living accommodation in accordance with Policy LP2 (Development and Amenity) of the Hackney Local Plan (2020).</span></p>

<p>The development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the expiration 
of three years beginning with the date of this permission
</p><p> REASON: In order to comply with the provisions of the Town and Country 
Planning Act 1990 as amended.</p>

<p>Prior to commencement of works, full details, with samples, of the materials to be used on the external surfaces 
of the buildings, including scaled drawing of&nbsp; fenestration showing 12-14mm glazing thickness&nbsp;shall be submitted to and approved by the 
Local Planning Authority in writing before any work on the site is commenced.  
The development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with 
the details thus approved.</p><p> REASON: To ensure that the external appearance of the building is satisfactory 
and does not detract from the character and visual amenity of the area</p>

<p><span id="docs-internal-guid-80362be0-7fff-3bff-94a2-270ddcc909f3"><span style="font-size: 11pt; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; background-color: transparent; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline; white-space-collapse: preserve;">Prior to superstructure works, detailed specification, a drainage layout and a management &amp; maintenance plan (where applicable) of at least one suitable sustainable drainage system (i.e. water butt with overflow, raingarden, bioretention planter box, living roof (substrate depth of 80-150mm excluding the vegetative mat), permeable paving etc.) shall be submitted to, and approved by the LPA, in consultation with the LLFA. If soakaways, i.e. plastic modules and soakaway rings are used, an infiltration test must be carried out to ensure that the capacity of the soil is suitable for infiltration. It must be demonstrated that there will be no increase in surface water flow being discharged offsite and an overall reduction in peak flow rate and volume. The development shall be constructed in accordance with the approved details.  </span></span></p><p><span id="docs-internal-guid-80362be0-7fff-3bff-94a2-270ddcc909f3"><span style="font-size: 11pt; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; background-color: transparent; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline; white-space-collapse: preserve;">Reason: In order to mitigate risk of flooding. </span></span></p>

<p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.38;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt;"><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">Prior to the commencement of any landscaping works to the front forecourt hereby approved, a detailed hard and soft landscaping scheme shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. This should include details of soft landscaping, hard landscaping, levels, sustainable urban drainage, and boundary treatments.</span></p><p><span id="docs-internal-guid-0d5233d3-7fff-dae9-8aaf-0ea2fbadd6bc"><br></span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.38;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt;"><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">REASON: To ensure that the development reduces surface water runoff and mitigates flood risk through the utilisation of Sustainable Drainage Systems (SuDS), while simultaneously enhancing local biodiversity and the visual amenity of the streetscene. This is to ensure compliance with the London Plan drainage hierarchy and Policies LP1 (Design and Character), LP47 (Biodiversity and Nature Conservation), and LP53 (Water and Flooding) of the Hackney Local Plan (2020).</span></p>

<div><font face="Arial" size="2">No&nbsp;</font><span style="font-family: Arial; font-size: small;">development shall commence, other than works of demolition, until a report (including intrusive investigation/trial pit and monitoring where necessary) demonstrating that the basement development will not increase the potential for groundwater&nbsp;</span><span class="il" style="font-family: Arial; font-size: small;">flooding</span><span style="font-family: Arial; font-size: small;">&nbsp;to itself or to the surrounding area during and post-construction has been submitted to the local planning authority for approval. Where groundwater is identified as a potential risk, details of appropriate controls including&nbsp;</span><span class="il" style="font-family: Arial; font-size: small;">flood</span><span style="font-family: Arial; font-size: small;">&nbsp;resilience and/or resistance measures shall be submitted to the LPA for approval and the approved measures incorporated before the basement is occupied. The basement shall be constructed and completed in accordance with the approved plans in line with BS 8102:2022 Protection of below ground structures against water ingress - code of practice.</span></div><div><span style="font-family: Arial; font-size: small;"><br></span></div><p><span id="docs-internal-guid-80362be0-7fff-3bff-94a2-270ddcc909f3"><span style="font-size: 11pt; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; background-color: transparent; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline; white-space-collapse: preserve;">Reason: In order to mitigate risk of flooding. </span></span></p>

<p>Prior to the first occupation of the development, detailed drawings (elevations and sections) of proposed cycle storage showing the provision of four secure and accessible cycle parking spaces shall be submitted to, and approved in writing by, the Local Planning Authority. The development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with the details thus approved, which shall be retained in perpetuity thereafter.<br><br>REASON: To ensure that reasonable and permanent provision is made within the site for the parking of a cycle in the interest of relieving congestion in surrounding streets and improving highway conditions in general.</p>

<p dir="ltr" style="line-height: 1.728; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; padding: 0pt 0pt 8pt;"><font color="#222222" face="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif" size="2">Prior to commencement of works, full details and specifications of the biosolar roof(s) shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Green roofs shall be planted with flowering species that provide amenity and biodiversity value at different times of the year. The submission shall include the following:&nbsp;</font></p><ul><li style="line-height: 1.728; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; padding: 0pt 0pt 8pt;"><font color="#222222" face="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif" size="2">Detailed drawings of a roof plan identifying where the green roofs will be located and the measurement of their coverage; this should include other structures on the roof including location of PV panels, roof lights and access points where applicable, and their relationship with the green roof;&nbsp;</font></li><li style="line-height: 1.728; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; padding: 0pt 0pt 8pt;">The design of the biosolar roof should be in line with GRO’s code of best practice;</li><li style="line-height: 1.728; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; padding: 0pt 0pt 8pt;">Section drawings demonstrating a minimum substrate depth of no less than 80mm for a sedum roof, 100mm for extensive living roofs (100mm - 150mm for wildflower species); and no less than 250mm for intensive living roof, 400mm for medium shrubs. </li><li style="line-height: 1.728; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; padding: 0pt 0pt 8pt;">Details of the proposed type of invertebrate habitat with a minimum of one feature per 30m2; which could include areas of bare, unplanted substrates, log piles, boulder or stone piles, sand piles; </li><li style="line-height: 1.728; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; padding: 0pt 0pt 8pt;">Details of the drainage system for the roof; </li><li style="line-height: 1.728; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; padding: 0pt 0pt 8pt;">Details of the planting mix (Including a minimum of 9+ species for sedum roof and including a minimum of 16+ species for wildflower/extensive roof)</li><li style="line-height: 1.728; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; padding: 0pt 0pt 8pt;">All roofs to be sown with a wide mix of species (standard is 15+ species), the roof should not rely on one species of plant life </li><li style="line-height: 1.728; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; padding: 0pt 0pt 8pt;">Management and maintenance plan, including access arrangements, irrigation, and general maintenance actions of biosolar roof;</li><li style="line-height: 1.728; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; padding: 0pt 0pt 8pt;">For biosolar roofs, details of how the roof's design meets fire and building safety requirements.&nbsp;</li></ul><div><br></div><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.728;background-color:#ffffff;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt;padding:0pt 0pt 8pt 0pt;"><span style="color: rgb(34, 34, 34); font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: small;"><br></span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.728;background-color:#ffffff;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt;padding:0pt 0pt 8pt 0pt;"><span style="color: rgb(34, 34, 34); font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: small;"><br></span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.728;background-color:#ffffff;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt;padding:0pt 0pt 8pt 0pt;"><span style="color: rgb(34, 34, 34); font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: small;"><br></span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.728;background-color:#ffffff;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt;padding:0pt 0pt 8pt 0pt;"><span style="color: rgb(34, 34, 34); font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: small;"><br></span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.728;background-color:#ffffff;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt;padding:0pt 0pt 8pt 0pt;"><br></p>

<p><font color="#333333">Prior to the occupation of the development hereby approved, details and full specifications of 2 bird/bat boxes shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority and shall be maintained for the lifespan of the development. The details should include:</font></p><ul><li><font color="#333333">Bird boxes incorporated into the design of the development, with a variety of box types (including different sized entrance holes) to provide habitat for diverse bird species. The boxes should be installed at or close to the eaves level of the development hereby approved. The boxes should be between 3 and 5 metres from the ground, and there should be a clear flight path without any obstructions below and directly in front of the box. The boxes should be facing north, east or north east (direct sunlight should be avoided), and should not be placed immediately above doors or windows. Boxes located in the same area should not be placed too close together.&nbsp;</font></li><li>Bat boxes incorporated into the design of the development. Boxes should be placed at or close to the eaves level of the development and at least 4m above the ground. The boxes should be placed away from artificial light sources and ideally located near dark tree lines or hedgerows where possible. The boxes should be located facing south, southeast or southwest, and exposed to sun for part of the day.</li></ul><p><font color="#333333">Reason:</font></p><p><font color="#333333">To support bird and bat populations, including swifts, in Hackney and preserve endangered urban biodiversity, by providing nesting opportunities, in accordance with Hackney’s Local Plan LP33 policy LP47 which states that all development schemes involving buildings with an eaves height or roof commencement height of 5 metres and above are required to provide nesting boxes for swifts, sparrows, starlings, and/or bats as appropriate.</font></p><div><br></div>
